"Jeeba!|Laparo and Thromba converse while working|}} '''Thromba''' was a [[Frigosian]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a [[cryptosurgeon]] in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]]. Along with her partner [[Laparo]], she offered cosmetic surgery to her clients, including the criminal [[Ryn Biggleston]]. Her lab was destroyed when the forces of the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and demolished Kanata's castle following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]]. ==Biography== [[File:The_Face_of_Evil_cover_art.png|thumb|left|250px|Thromba and Laparo with a client.]] Thromba was a [[Frigosian]] [[Gender|female]] from [[Tansyl 5]] who worked in partnership with her fellow Frigosian [[Laparo]] as a [[cryptosurgeon]] around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. The pair rented out a tower in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]], and there offered cosmetic surgery to those who wanted to disappear. When the criminal [[Ryn Biggleston]] hired the services of Thromba and Laparo after [[Death|killing]] her partner in crime [[BeeLee Amdas]], the pair transformed Biggleston's appearance to that of Amdas without her knowing and stole a hoard of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] she had hidden near the castle. The patient then fled without paying, but was soon arrested when the criminal Amdas' appearance was recognized. Thromba and Laparo were later present in the castle's main hall when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entered with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. Soon after the group's arrival, many of the castle's occupants raced outside to watch the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]], after which forces of the First Order [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed Kanata's castle and the cryptosurgeon's lab with it.{{Film|VII}} ==Behind the scenes== Thromba first appeared in "[[The Face of Evil]]," a short story written by [[Landry Q. Walker]] as part of the ''[[Journey to Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'', a multi-media campaign leading up to the release of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] later that year in [[2015]]. She and Laparo then appeared as minor characters in the film itself portrayed by [[Annabelle Davis]]. ==Appearances== *"[[The Face of Evil]]" {{Reprint|The Face of Evil}} {{1st}} *{{Film|VII}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *''[[The Force Awakens: Rey's Story]]'' {{Ab|The Force Awakens: Rey's Story (audiobook)}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' {{DLC}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *{{HelmetCollectionCite|59|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' *''[[Star Wars: How Not to Get Eaten by Ewoks and Other Galactic Survival Skills]]'' {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Thromba |ja=スロンバ |ka=თრომბა |pl=Thromba }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Frigosians]] [[Category:Healers and doctors]]
